# Prompt caching — LLM caching strategies and patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor — @sickn33's prompt-caching skill (adapted from vibeship-spawner-skills, Apache 2.0): LLM-specific caching strategies — Anthropic's native prompt caching for stable prefixes, response caching (Redis/Upstash patterns), KV-cache concepts, Cache-Augmented Generation (CAG) patterns and cache invalidation — with scope boundaries (no CDN or database query caching) and a recommended companion skill for context-window management. Honest caveats: provider pricing and cache mechanics change fast — treat the patterns as principles and check current provider docs; a real LLM API key is needed to use any of it. MIT licensed.
